summary: Senstar Technologies Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, reporting its second-quarter 2026 financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The release discloses an 8% year-over-year revenue increase to $10.4 million, gross margin of 64.2%, net income of $0.4 million, and $8.0 million in cash with no debt. Management commentary references ongoing integration of Blickfeld, Q2 EBITDA profitability, and the impact of U.S. government shutdown project delays. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation; the conference call and ordinary financial disclosure do not constitute a covered event.
